header.flip.you: Flip a card next to an Element card or to the Elementis card
header.flip.you.no-effect: No power can be applied: flip a card next to an Element card, its power will have no effect
header.power.you.push: Click an arrow to insert the played card at the end of its row or column
power.1: Swap an inside card with another inside card, central card included.
power.2: Swap an outside card with another outside card.
power.3: Swap an outside card with an inside card, central card included.
power.4: Swap two cards in the column of the played card.
power.5: Swap two cards in the row of the played card.
power.7: Remove the played card, insert it from the outside by pushing the cards towards the hole formed.
power.8: Swap two cards on a diagonal of the played card.
power.9: Swap two adjacent cards with each other, horizontally or vertically.
power.10: Swap two cards that have one card between them, horizontally or vertically.
power.13: Swap any card with the Elementis card.
power.15: Swap the played card with an orthogonally adjacent card.
zones.title: Largest zones
result.won: Victory! You score {score} points out of 24 ({threshold} needed)
result.lost: Defeat: you score {score} points out of 24, {threshold} were needed
help.power-side.title: Card on its power side
help.power-side.hidden: Its element is hidden: the power side is the same for the 4 elements. It is revealed when the card is flipped.
help.power-side.flip: On your turn, flip a card on its power side that touches an Element card or the Elementis card by a side, then apply its power. A card whose power cannot be applied cannot be chosen, unless no card can: its power then has no effect.
help.element.title: {element} Element card
help.element.zone: At the end of the game, for each element, only the largest zone of cards adjacent by a side counts: 1 point per card.
help.element.largest: Current largest zone of this element: {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}.
help.element.swap: Two cards of the same element cannot be swapped.
help.rules.title: Rules of the powers
help.rules.compulsory: The power is compulsory as soon as it can be applied.
help.rules.anchor: A power always moves at least one card on its element side or the Elementis card.
help.rules.inverse: You may not make the inverse of the move of the previous turn: the cards it moved are outlined with dashes.
help.rules.same-element: You may not swap two cards of the same element.
help.elementis.title: Elementis card
help.elementis.start: It is visible from the start: on the first turn, flip a card that touches it by a side.
help.elementis.move: The powers can move it like the other cards, and swap it with any card.
help.elementis.score: It scores no points and does not link the zones of elements.
help.help-card.title: Help card
help.help-card.cards: This power is on 4 cards of the grid, one of each element.
help.silence: Elementis is played without talking: cooperate in silence!

tuto.welcome: Welcome to the <bold>Elementis</bold> tutorial! You play with Olwen, one of the authors of the game: Elementis is a <bold>cooperative</bold> game, played <bold>without talking</bold>.
tuto.goal:
Together, create zones of adjacent cards of the same element: <bold>Water, Fire, Earth and Air</bold>.
At the end of the game, only the <bold>largest zone of each element</bold> counts: 1 point per card, 24 points at most. You need <bold>22 points</bold> to win.
tuto.grid: The grid of 5 × 5 cards is laid <bold>power side up</bold>: the element of each card is hidden.
tuto.help-cards: These 6 <bold>Help cards</bold> explain the powers of the game. Click a card at any time to see its help.
tuto.turn: On your turn, flip a card that touches an Element card or the <bold>Elementis card</bold> by a side, then apply its power: it is compulsory as soon as it is possible.
tuto.flip.first: On the first turn, no card is flipped yet: start from the Elementis card. <bold>Click the card above it</bold> to flip it.
tuto.power.first:
It is a <bold>Water</bold> card. Its power: swap the played card with an orthogonally adjacent card.
<bold>Drag it onto the Elementis card</bold> to swap them.
tuto.partner: Olwen’s turn. She flips the card below your Water card…
tuto.zone: … another <bold>Water</bold> card! The 2 cards touch by a side: they form a zone of 2 cards. Olwen now applies her power.
tuto.last-move:
Olwen swapped the Elementis card with its neighbour. The cards moved on the previous turn are <bold>outlined with dashes</bold>: you may not make the inverse move.
Two cards of the same element can never be swapped.
tuto.flip.push: Your turn. <bold>Flip the card on the right of your Water card.</bold>
tuto.push:
A <bold>Fire</bold> card, with the power: remove the played card, insert it from the outside by pushing the cards towards the hole formed.
The card waits beside the board: <bold>click the arrow on the right of its row</bold> to insert it there.
tuto.score: The <bold>Largest zones</bold> panel, on the right, gives the size of the largest zone of each element and the total. In expert mode, it is hidden until the end.
tuto.go: The game ends when all the cards are flipped. Now finish it with Olwen: good luck!
